EnglishInfo.Description: Quarz 201 is a lovely apartment in the Vieil Alpe district of Alpe d'Huez. The center with restaurants and bars is situated at 400 meters. This apartment is suitable for 4 persons, is lovely decorated and offers you 2 separate bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a cozy living room and a kitchen. This apartment is suitable for 4 persons.
